criteria.intent: Short current entry and scoped retrieval, with full inventory and legacy interface compatibility.
criteria.automated_scope: Named RI map/scope/prefix/paging/directory/external-owner/whole-response and actual EN-UA/current-repository tests check concrete outputs and refusal behavior. Connector-only usability and owner presentation/budget acceptance remain separate source-bound evidence; passing fixtures does not establish those decisions.

criteria.intent: Full deterministic byte integrity and live/historical instruction safety under unchanged input limits.
criteria.automated_scope: All existing permanent RI behavioral regressions, actual complete native inventory/CLI freshness, and current coupling validate bytes, path/mode admission, missing/unsafe/tampered inputs, serialization, request binding, limits and instruction scope. This is ordinary candidate-code test execution, not a hostile-code security guarantee or semantic integrity review.

criteria.intent: Eligible frozen nineteen-file archive batch with exact recovery, useful locators and protected resource closure.
criteria.automated_scope: Owning task checks pin the frozen selection digest, all nineteen identities, unchanged three ZIPs, actual unzip bytes, original gzip/gallery local closure, exact deletion/addition sets and every nonexception base mode/blob. They cannot prove eligibility, completeness of historical consumer discovery, rights or browser playback.

criteria.intent: Complete actual resource accounting and sustainable lossless maintenance with at least10000000bytes final hash headroom.
criteria.automated_scope: Current complete native source check asserts fixed five hard caps, exact protected scope, separately summed input/derived/tracked totals and final>=10MB headroom. Existing capacity boundary/unsafe/over-limit/advisory tests preserve diagnostics versus integrity and refusal semantics. Interpretation of all final evidence costs, largest margins and maintenance remains an independent review, without a perpetual-growth claim.

criteria.intent: Proportionate style/test allocation, actual independent review and trusted exact-source delivery.
criteria.automated_scope: Current bounded style/coupling and fixed local Basic check verify their declared subset. This policy routes the new numeric task module only through its owner; it neither launches reviewers nor certifies architectural readability, hosted obligations, maintainer attestation, delivery or merge. Full-diff lane comes from protected-base selection, not this JSON. The shared protected-closure check also invokes the existing Node complete test-registry validator and confines this task registration to its owning policy. Its exact ledger exception preserves every predecessor row and metadata field, compares only109 individually proven appended dispositions to a pinned bounded proof, and runs the real closed-ledger loader; semantic public-identity review remains external.

NAVIGATION.description: Reconcile actual accepted entry budget/presentation and independent lookup/compatibility usability, including exact published-ref short-map/direct-owner connector journey without fullJSON/local-verification claims. Reuse recorded maintainer decisions only for their actual scope; unresolved owner judgment remains pending.

INTEGRITY.description: Independent source/integrity review and current complete-checkout/consumer verification on exact final source, including all applicable corrections. Fixture-only or stale-source evidence is insufficient.

ARCHIVE-ELIGIBILITY.description: Revalidate frozen original owner/delivery/supersession, actual current and pinned open-PR consumers/exclusions, every-member practical recovery/guidance and protected resources. Historical manifests/failures/reviews remain exact. Checksums alone are not eligibility or media-playback acceptance.

CAPACITY.description: Review final actual hash-input/tracked/derived accounting including all policy/tests/metadata/receipts/evidence, all five margins and218-byte ledger risk. Preserve in-repo archives/existing process; final>=10MB is accepted target, under10MB advice is not another hard CI gate. No infinite-growth guarantee.

REVIEW.description: Four actual distinct source-bound role first executions and affected corrections, required none-fork launch receipts/provider unknowns, exact-source test-impact allocation and CS01/04/05/07/08/09/10 review. A passing structural/keyword test or policy cannot supply semantic quality or reviewer execution.

DELIVERY.description: Use actual protected-main complete-diff selection and current exact-head reviewed_sha/maintainer control decision. Run every selected source/RI/owning/full-hosted/admission obligation on authentic sources; Draft preview/local Basic does not authorize Ready/staging/production or repository-only exemption. Record tested versus effective source distinctly.

MERGE.description: Normal trusted protected merge after required current checks and applicable maintainer decisions; verify accepted merged result and record exact merged/effective identities. Do not infer merge/production authority from this policy.
